name: Turning Totems
review:
Turning Totems is an 11-line slot with two-way wins, thunder reels, sleeping wilds, thunder snakes, respins and a bonus game.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, but with a 9,986x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

Thunder reels, sleeping wilds and thunder snakes give the base game plenty to watch. Despite the low volatility, the cap reaches nearly 10,000x.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
